title: The Mystery of Moving Rocks

scenes.text: Why do rocks slide alone across Racetrack Playa in California?

scenes.text: Scientists showed that a thin sheet of ice, wind, and a bit of water let the rocks glide across the mud when the playa briefly freezes.

description: The desert’s moving stones have a perfectly scientific explanation—no ghosts needed. Discover the icy formula that makes the rocks slide. Hit follow for more truth‑busting mysteries.
